sources.verified_angle_summary: Masdar, a company specializing in data solutions and business empowerment, announced its participation as a Gold Sponsor at LEAP 2026 in Riyadh (August 31 - September 3, 2026). The company will showcase a suite of data, AI, system integration, and compliance solutions. Key highlights include the "Mofeed" unified data services platform for fintech, insurance, and government sectors; "Aamaly" for HR and social insurance integration; "Labeeb," an AI-powered customer interaction management platform; and the Health Insurance Compliance (HIP) platform. Abdulrahim Al-Zahrani, Executive General Manager of Products at Masdar, emphasized the company's commitment to enabling digital transformation in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 by providing smart infrastructure to various business sectors. This announcement provides specific product details and strategic focus areas for Masdar at LEAP 2026, distinct from other general event coverage.
